# TestHydrateSite
> Sovereign Multi-Agent Cryptographic Layer

## Overview
Eliminate cloud key leakage with Argon2id hardware encryption, local loopback RPC gates, and multi-agent peer arbitration.

## Architecture & Features
- **Argon2id Enclave**: Hardware-backed cryptographic secret derivation with memory-hard zero-knowledge boundaries.
- **Loopback Zero-Egress**: Local-first IPC socket gates ensuring API keys never touch public network hops.
- **Swarm Peer Locks**: Decentralized state arbitration preventing race conditions across concurrent agent threads.
- **Real-Time Telemetry**: Microsecond latency telemetry with Shannon entropy agreement verification.
